desc:
SS2 Highlights 

Get ready and turn up the volume to the max!

Welcome to the world of music lovers, where you can create and customize your car's sound system in your own unique way, from small sets for casual listening to large sound systems that can rock the whole yard.

- Select the device you like.
- Arrange and adjust the sound system.
- Experiment with sound and volume in your own style.
- Create a distinctive and unique sound set.

Whether you're a heavy bass player, a mid-range vocalist, or someone who likes sharp, high-pitched sounds, every style has its own space for you to explore.

SS2 audition - Whose voice you hear, you can audition for that role
